requirements.title: IS_CONTIGUOUS admits ARRAY of any type
requirements.definition: The language admits IS_CONTIGUOUS ARRAY arguments of any type; this is a permission/admission, not a processor result requirement by itself.
requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures use exact integer, logical, character, shape, kind, and bit-pattern observations, and use real values only for exact operations or standard inquiry-model values. Every positive plan establishes a non-default state first, uses a conforming companion for zero, .FALSE., or blank results that could otherwise be vacuous, and includes a feature mutation such as changing the intrinsic name, argument order, KIND, DIM, SIZE, or SHIFT value. Unnumbered argument shall-restrictions are source-control restrictions only and are not promoted to diagnostic facets. Bit-result intrinsic plans observe selected bits with BTEST or BOZ-pattern comparison rather than relying on numeric interpretation of a leftmost bit.

requirements.title: IS_CONTIGUOUS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be assumed-rank or an array, and pointer ARRAY arguments shall be associated.

pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-pointer-ARRAY-associated: PENDING after batch301 review: this is an unnumbered pointer association restriction; a positive associated-pointer control does not discharge the forbidden disassociated-pointer case, and no diagnostic is required.

accounting.rationale: Description defines the intrinsic purpose and cross-references CONTIGUOUS concepts.
Classifies IS_CONTIGUOUS as an inquiry function.
Arguments paragraph is split into the any-type admission and the remaining program restrictions.
Admits ARRAY arguments of any type; it is not a requirement that any particular type-specific result differ.
Unnumbered program restrictions on ARRAY form and pointer association.
Exact logical result value for rank-zero, contiguous, and noncontiguous cases.
Example paragraph is illustrative; the false strided-pointer case is already covered by Result Value text.

review_rationale: Batch301 bound reference-validated ISHFTC-LBOUND fixtures after two review rounds; three frozen-LFortran failures (assumed-rank IS_CONTIGUOUS ICEs and LBOUND rejection) were independently confirmed as genuine.
